chief_complaint: Lung cancer surveillance and respiratory symptoms related to COPD
history_of_present_illness: The patient was diagnosed in early 2005 with stage 1 non‑small cell lung carcinoma and concurrent pulmonary emphysema. He underwent chemotherapy (paclitaxel and cisplatin) and has had intensive thoracic imaging surveillance, including multiple CT scans in April 2007. His chronic obstructive lung disease requires daily inhaled bronchodilator and corticosteroid therapy. He also has long‑standing essential hypertension managed with a three‑drug regimen, obesity, pre‑diabetes, anemia, and hip osteoarthritis treated with NSAIDs. Recent visits are dominated by inpatient admissions and imaging related to his cancer work‑up, with few outpatient encounters. Socially, he works full‑time but reports transportation barriers and has a criminal record, which may affect follow‑up.
